Let’s break down the SVG path.  

The path contains two arc commands (`A`), each with the same radius values (28.15, 28.15), and both arcs have the large-arc flag set to 1 and sweep flag set to 0.  

The first arc goes from (66.80, 92.60) to (42.74, 41.70), and the second arc goes from (42.74, 41.70) back to (66.80, 92.60).  

Because the radii are equal (28.15, 28.15) and the rotation is 64.71 degrees, this describes an ellipse (equal radii would be a circle, but here the rotation implies it’s an ellipse drawn at an angle).  

Also, the path closes with two elliptical arcs, forming a full ellipse.  

Final answer: (K)
